subject.title: Media generation succeeds but completion delivery fails and looks like generation failure

question: Should this broad issue remain the canonical generated-media completion delivery tracker until the wake-false, cron-context, and output-contract mechanisms are all resolved, or should maintainers split the remaining mechanisms now and close this broader item after linking them?
rationale: The missing-target slice is fixed, but the remaining behavior spans fallback policy, session continuation, and output-contract ownership; automation should not decide the permanent canonical-tracker shape or fallback contract alone.

options.title: Keep Broad Canonical For Now
options.body: Keep this issue open as the parent tracker while reviewing the open focused follow-ups and only close it once each remaining mechanism is resolved or explicitly split.

options.title: Split And Close After Linking
options.body: Create or confirm focused canonical issues for every remaining mechanism, then close this issue as superseded by those narrower trackers.

options.title: Narrow To Output-Contract Only
options.body: Treat wake-false and cron context as owned by their follow-ups and repurpose this issue only for the structured media handoff/output-contract gap.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Canonical For Now
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the parent tracker while reviewing the open focused follow-ups and only close it once each remaining mechanism is resolved or explicitly split.

likelyOwner.reason: They reopened the issue with the current canonical-tracker boundary and have recent adjacent media/cron completion routing commits.
